# Terraform plan

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-docs.mjs. Edit the manifest, then run `make docs`. -->

Plan a Terraform/OpenTofu root and render a reviewable summary

```yaml
- uses: patrickisgreat/actions-toolkit/actions/terraform-plan@v1
  with:
    working-directory: # Root module directory to plan.
```

## How it works

Run `terraform plan` and turn it into something a human can review on a PR.

What it produces beyond a raw plan:
  • A saved binary plan file, so apply runs *exactly* what was reviewed rather than
    re-planning against state that may have moved. This is the whole point of separating
    plan from apply.
  • `has-changes`, derived from `-detailed-exitcode`, so an apply job can skip itself
    entirely when there is nothing to do.
  • Add/change/destroy counts and a fenced, collapsible Markdown body written to a file,
    ready to hand to the `pr-comment` action.
  • A `destroys` flag, because "this plan deletes things" is the one signal worth gating
    an environment on.

Init runs with whatever backend config you pass. Credentials come from a prior `aws-auth`
/ `gcp-auth` step; this action never handles them.

## Inputs

| Input | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `working-directory` | **yes** | — | Root module directory to plan. |
| `binary` | no | `terraform` | terraform \| tofu |
| `init-args` | no | `""` | Extra args appended to `init`. |
| `backend-config` | no | `""` | Newline-separated `key=value` backend settings, or paths to `.hcl` files. Each becomes a `-backend-config=` flag. |
| `workspace` | no | `""` | Workspace to select or create. Empty uses `default`. |
| `var-files` | no | `""` | Newline-separated `.tfvars` paths, each passed as `-var-file`. |
| `vars` | no | `""` | Newline-separated `key=value` pairs, each passed as `-var`. |
| `target` | no | `""` | Newline-separated resource addresses to `-target`. Use sparingly. |
| `destroy` | no | `false` | true to plan a destroy. |
| `refresh` | no | `true` | false to plan with `-refresh=false` (faster, riskier). |
| `plan-file` | no | `tfplan.binary` | Path for the saved binary plan, relative to `working-directory`. |
| `plan-args` | no | `""` | Extra args appended to `plan`. |
| `max-comment-chars` | no | `50000` | Truncate the rendered plan body to this many characters. |

## Outputs

| Output | Description |
|---|---|
| `exit-code` | `-detailed-exitcode` result: `0` no changes, `2` changes. `1` fails the step. |
| `has-changes` | `true` when the plan contains changes. |
| `destroys` | `true` when the plan destroys at least one resource. |
| `add` | Count of resources to add. |
| `change` | Count of resources to change. |
| `destroy` | Count of resources to destroy. |
| `plan-file` | Path to the saved binary plan, relative to the workspace root. |
| `comment-body-file` | Path to a Markdown file summarizing the plan, for `pr-comment`. |
